source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 4. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: As-Samee': Allah hears everyone, even a silent prayer

learn.en: Allah is As-Samee', The All-Hearing. He is always listening to us.
learn.title: The All-Hearing

learn.en: People only hear what is said out loud. Allah hears everything — loud or quiet, even a tiny whisper.
learn.title: Hearing without limits

learn.en: Allah hears the silent prayers of our hearts, even when we use no words at all.
learn.title: Hearing the unspoken

learn.en: If two children talk to their parents at once, the parents get confused. Allah hears everyone in the world at the same time.
learn.title: Everyone at once

learn.en: You can talk to Allah anywhere — in bed, in the car, at school — and ask Him for anything.
learn.title: Anywhere, any time

learn.en: “There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.” (Qur'an 42:11)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: True or false? We always have to move our lips so Allah can hear our prayers.
True or false? Allah hears the silent cry of the heart.
Where can we pray and talk to Allah?
How does Allah hear all the people in the world?
opts: He listens to them one by one
He hears everyone at the same time
He only hears people who shout

think.q: You are worried about a test, and the classroom is very quiet. What can you do?
think.a: Talk to Allah in your heart! You don't need words — As-Samīʿ hears your silent prayer.

parents.summary: As-Samīʿ: Allah hears everyone at once, loud or silent, so we can ask Him anywhere, any time.
parents.tip: Before sleep, encourage him to make a quiet duʿāʾ in his own words.
